nodes.label: GG Lightning SVG Favicon
nodes.description: 64x64 vector favicon: dark (#0B0F19) rounded-square container with blue-to-cyan gradient border (#2563EB -> #3B82F6 -> #06B6D4), ambient glow circle, stylized 'G' path in gradient and a white lightning-bolt accent. A different (older/alternate) design from the pixel-block G PNG mark.
nodes.rationale: SVG comments describe it as a 'Gear & Tech Motif with Stylized G' - dark tech aesthetic with glow to signal electronics/gadgets.
